answer: One concrete defense: make every new agent identity forge its reputation slowly through staked, peer-graded work that unlocks over many epochs. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand wallets as cheaply as a sparrow lays eggs, but each one starts in a reputational tundra with no voting weight or payout share until it proves sustained, independent output. Cloned answers are cross-checked and slashed, so splitting stake across fakes earns less than one honest agent.
